{{Quote|We need someone who understands the binary language of Verossian computers, huh? Say, I think I know who might be able to help!|An individual, to their companions|<ref name="HR" />}}
The '''Verossian computer''' was a type of [[Computer/Legends|computer]]<ref name="HR" /> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Verossia system/Legends|Verossia system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Strabin sector/Legends|Strabin sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Verossian computers utilized the [[Binary/Legends|binary]] [[Language/Legends|language]],<ref name="HR" /> which was also spoken by [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="Phrase">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>

{{RPGseed}}
At one point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of individuals was in need of understanding the binary of Verossian computers. One of the group's members then realized a contact of theirs could help with their problem.<ref name="HR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Verossian computer was mentioned in the [[1995]] sourcebook ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', authored by [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] and [[Paul Sudlow]] and published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The book mentions the type of computer in an example line of dialogue illustrating the role professional contacts may play in developing the backstory of the player characters. This article assumes the situation plays out as described.<ref name="HR" />
